company: Ocior Energy India Pvt Ltd
notes: Ocior Energy is a developer of green hydrogen and green ammonia facilities. The company was founded in 2022 and is based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

company: Jindal Stainless and Hygenco
notes: The fully automated plant has been set up by Jindal Stainless in association with Hygenco Green Energy Private Limited, a global leader in deploying green hydrogen solutions. The facility aims at abating around 54,000 tonnes of CO2 emissions over 20 years and is based on a long-term off-take agreement.

company: Jindal Steel & Power (JSPL) and Jindal Renewables
notes: JSPL plans to incorporate green hydrogen into its Direct Reduced Iron units. In the first phase, Jindal Renewables will develop a green hydrogen generation capacity of up to 4500 tones per annum, set to commence by December 2025. The project will also supply 36,000 tons of oxygen annually to the Angul steelworks and ~3 GW of renewable energy to JSPL's facilities. [Announcement year: 2024]

company: Essar Group
operational_date: Investments will be made over the next 3-4 years

company: JSW Energy Ltd.
operational_date: Pilot project will begin in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025
notes: The 25-MW green hydrogen project in Karnataka is for the group company JSW Steel Ltd. To manufacture green steel. Work on a 3800 tonne per annum pilot project has started and is likely to be commissioned by the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025. JSW Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with JSW Steel to supply additional 90,000 tonne per annum, or TPA, of green hydrogen and 7,20,000 TPA of oxygen by 2030. The green hydrogen project is co-located with the JSW Steel plant which will enable the company to save on storage costs. [Announcement year: 2024]
